map.双层复合壁总热阻与热流: Total thermal resistance and heat flow of a double-layer composite wall
map.输入两层的厚度、导热系数与面积，求总热阻、总温差热流。: Enter the thickness, conductivity and area of both layers to find the total thermal resistance and heat flow under a total temperature difference.
map.📖 查看「双层复合壁总热阻与热流 使用指南」: View "Total thermal resistance and heat flow of a double-layer composite wall" guide
map.R=R1+R2，U=1/R_total。 保温层+砖墙示例可得低 U 值。: R=R1+R2, U=1/R_total. An insulation+brick wall example yields a low U value.
map.保温层+砖墙示例可得低 U 值。: An insulation+brick wall example yields a low U value.
map.多层平壁总热阻 R=ΣL/(kA)。: Total thermal resistance of a multilayer plane wall R=sum L/(kA).
map.由总温差求热流 q=ΔT/ΣR。: Find heat flow q=DeltaT/sum R from the total temperature difference.
map.L1 0.1→0.2：R_tot=4.7 K/W，热流减半。: L1 0.1->0.2: R_tot=4.7 K/W, heat flow halved.
map.热阻串联同电阻，总温差按热阻分配，热流处处相等。: Series thermal resistance is like series resistance; the total temperature difference is divided by resistance and the heat flow is equal everywhere.
map.实际多层间有接触热阻，设计常留余量。: Real multilayers have contact thermal resistance; design usually leaves a margin.
map.双层壁串联热阻（本页代码口径，含单层定义）：R₁=L₁÷(k₁×A)、R₂=L₂: Two-layer wall series thermal resistance (this page's code basis, including the single-layer definition): R₁ = L₁÷(k₁×A), R₂ = L₂÷(k₂×A) (K/W, L layer thickness in m, k thermal conductivity in W/(m·K), A area in m²); total resistance R = R₁+R₂ (K/W), overall heat transfer coefficient U = 1÷(R₁+R₂) (W/(m²·K)). Validation: empty input in any of the five fields prompts and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; a thicker layer or lower conductivity raises the resistance and lowers U, giving better insulation.
